producer_report.summary: `cargo run -p xtask -- site` now writes `index.html` to `site/` inside the cargo target directory (`$CARGO_TARGET_DIR`, else `target/site`). Before, the default `site/` was in the repository root, so a build there wrote into a verifier's work tree. The xtask now refuses any `--out` inside the repository root unless it is under the target directory; unit tests cover that refusal and the default path. The Pages workflow uploads `target/site`. The README, the design note and the usage text say where the page goes and why. `.gitignore` drops its `/site` entry, because that location is no longer used. CHANGELOG has a Fixed entry. Athena's snapshot check is untouched. I could not reproduce the original failure, since the verifier transcripts are not available. The fix removes the repository-root write at its source and refuses it in code.

checks_run.note: Whole workspace run exited 0. The output was too large to read, so I confirmed the xtask part separately with cargo test --locked -p xtask: 17 unit tests and 9 policy tests passed.

checks_run.command: cargo run -q -p xtask -- site, then git status --short
checks_run.note: The page was written to <CARGO_TARGET_DIR>/site/index.html. git status showed only my edited files and no new files in the work tree. `--out site` was refused with a clear error.

criteria_check.criterion: In a verifier-like setting, run `cargo run -p xtask -- site`, then `git status --short`. The status output is empty, and index.html exists under the cargo target directory's site/ folder rather than in the repository root.
criteria_check.evidence: I ran `cargo run -q -p xtask -- site` with CARGO_TARGET_DIR set. It printed 'wrote .../target/produce/site/index.html', which is under the target directory. git status afterwards listed only my edited files and no untracked files. On a clean checkout the status would be empty.

criteria_check.criterion: `cargo test -p xtask` passes. It includes a test that the default output directory is not inside the repository work tree. It also has a test that `--out` pointing inside the repo root, apart from the ignored target directory, is refused with a clear error. The existing build_writes_index_html test still passes.
criteria_check.evidence: cargo test --locked -p xtask passed 17 of 17. The new tests are the_default_output_is_in_the_target_directory_not_the_work_tree and an_output_inside_the_repository_root_is_refused_with_a_clear_error. build_writes_index_html_at_the_output_root passed.
cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings finished clean, and cargo fmt --all --check printed nothing.

criteria_check.criterion: .github/workflows/pages.yml uploads the new output directory, and its path matches the xtask default (for example `target/site`). The workflow stays a thin call into `cargo run --locked -p xtask -- site`.
criteria_check.evidence: The upload-pages-artifact path is now target/site, and the build step is still `cargo run --locked -p xtask -- site`. The header comment was updated to match.

criteria_check.criterion: docs/design/explainer-site.md and the xtask usage text state where the page is written and why. The reason is that building must not change the verifier's snapshot. The old `/site` location is no longer described as the default.
criteria_check.evidence: The design note and the SITE_USAGE constant in xtask/src/main.rs both name site/ in the cargo target directory and give the snapshot reason. The README matches. A grep for the old 'gitignored' default wording found no remaining description of it.

criteria_check.criterion: CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased] has an entry saying building the explainer page no longer writes into the work tree, so a verifier's snapshot stays unchanged.
criteria_check.evidence: A new '### Fixed' entry under [Unreleased] says this.

open_issues: I could not confirm which path changed the rejected verifiers' hash; the transcripts are not in the snapshot. If the cause was something other than an xtask write inside the tree, this fix would not cover it.
The older CHANGELOG entry for the original site feature still says 'site/index.html (gitignored)'. I left it as history.
mistakes: My first version of main.rs did not call the new default_out helper, and clippy flagged it as dead code. I fixed that by routing the default through default_out.
learnings: Bash in this role cannot pipe, and Read, Grep and Glob cannot open files outside the working directory, so large cargo test output saved outside the work tree cannot be searched. Run narrower test commands instead.
In this job CARGO_TARGET_DIR was set to a directory outside the work tree, so the page lands there. Without it the default is target/site.
desires: The rejected verifier transcripts, to confirm the exact path that changed the snapshot.
